panels.title: Tag detail — latest sample per consumer

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  panel AS "Panel",
  component AS "Component",
  consumer AS "Consumer",
  active_power_total AS "Active power",
  power_factor_total AS "Power factor",
  current_a AS "Ia", current_b AS "Ib", current_c AS "Ic",
  voltage_an AS "Van", voltage_bn AS "Vbn", voltage_cn AS "Vcn",
  timestamp AS "Last seen",
  extract(epoch from now()) - extract(epoch from timestamp) AS "Age"
FROM (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY topic ORDER BY timestamp DESC) AS rn
  FROM public."power_tags"
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (('$panel' = 'All' AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3', '10P1')) OR panel = '$panel') AND ',' || '${consumer:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || topic || ',%'
) t WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY panel, component

SELECT
  date_bin('$__interval', timestamp) AS time,
  CASE WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' AND coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN component || ' · ' || consumer WHEN coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN consumer WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' THEN component ELSE topic END AS "Consumer",
  avg(active_power_total) AS "Total active power"
FROM public."power_tags"
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND (('$panel' = 'All' AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3', '10P1')) OR panel = '$panel') AND ',' || '${consumer:csv}' || ',' LIKE '%,' || topic || ',%'
  AND active_power_total IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, topic, component, consumer
ORDER BY 2, 1 ASC

list.definition:
SELECT topic AS __value, CASE WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' AND coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN component || ' · ' || consumer WHEN coalesce(consumer, '') <> '' THEN consumer WHEN coalesce(component, '') <> '' THEN component ELSE topic END AS __text
FROM public."power_tags"
WHERE (('$panel' = 'All' AND panel IN ('10P0-1', '10P0-3', '10P1')) OR panel = '$panel')
GROUP BY topic, component, consumer
ORDER BY 2
